title: Ninjutsu
description: Use webcam hand signs to summon a spinning Rasenshuriken, gather lightning, create shadow clones, and vanish in a burst of smoke.

prompt.objective: Build a webcam ninjutsu playground with hand-tracked energy effects, shadow clones, and a disappearing act.

mintAssets.brief: A translucent cyan four-blade energy shuriken and a kunai-studded substitution log.

experience: Track open palms and two-handed seals locally to trigger effects.
Anchor spinning energy and lightning to hands; clone or erase the player using segmentation.
prompt.visualDirection: Cyan plasma, branching lightning, soft smoke, and restrained overlays on live video.

thumbnail.alt: A test-frame player holding a glowing cyan Rasenshuriken and branching blue lightning over two open palms.
